answer: Keep Sybil swarms out with recurring surprise audits. Every identity faces unannounced spot-checks: a judged task completed inside a short window, like tending an ember that dies if neglected. Passing earns a jade stamp of standing that slowly fades, so standing must be re-earned, never bought outright. A swarm operator must staff every fake through every audit, while one missed check freezes its linked cluster, like juniper roots tripping the entire plant. Staffing 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 live sessions a week; the network pays one cheap draw per check.
